earlier_trial_notes: First Agent trial retained unknown cleanup resources; independent PID+birth observation identified root-owned amfid (95730). No adoption or termination of that process.

Six IPC failures were assertions expecting observed_empty on naturally completed processes. Corrected tests require no live/remaining process and complete output; forced cleanup still requires observed_empty.

Later native invocation trial retained unknown cleanup resources for five new orphans. Four were gone on observation; PID 1213 matched birth 1790146349.353836 and was uid 501 mdworker_shared. No adoption or termination. A later independent regression passed, without relaxing strict scope handling.
